description: VAT number check against VIES: use when you only need the tax half of verifying a supplier before payment: confirm that a counterparty's intra-community VAT number really exists before invoicing it, applying the reverse charge or paying it. It is a required check under the French e-invoicing mandate of 1 September 2026 and under the Belgian B2B mandate in force since 1 January 2026. Validates any EU intra-community VAT number against the official VIES service (all member states) and returns valid or invalid, the registered name and address when the member state publishes them, and the VIES consultation identifier as proof. Name and address are served only for a holder that its number's format or its country's register (BE, PL, LV, HR, RO, SE, CZ, DK, FI, FR) proves a legal person; any other holder (natural person, undecided form, missing from its register, or in a state where no register qualifies it: AT, CY, DE, EE, EL, HU, IE, IT, LT, LU, MT, NL, SI, SK, XI) gets neither, the omission counted in ecartes by reason. A register that cannot qualify the holder (down, quota reached, or its local copy not yet built: cause collecte_en_cours) leaves both out as a doubt, says its register and cause in qualification_en_echec, and nothing is cached. A VIES outage (member state down or saturated) returns error 503 amont_indisponible, not charged: retry later; never a false invalid. The response is Ed25519-signed and carries provenance[]: the VIES entry with the date the number was really consulted, never a fabricated one. Paid via x402 ($0.003 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

vat_number.description: Full VAT number with its 2-letter country prefix and no spaces, e.g. FR27552032534

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: validate_eu_vat_number
